sources.title: The difference between The Witcher 3 and Witcher 4 will be 'comparable' to that of GTA 5 and GTA 6, CD Projekt boss says: 'I mean, it's been 11 years'
sources.text: CD Projekt Red reported its Q3 earnings today, but all anyone wanted to talk about was GTA 6. CD Projekt made its Q3 2026 financial report today, and there's not a whole lot to see: The Witcher 3 remaster was a big hit, work on Cyberpunk 2 and The Witcher 4 is ticking along, and everyone really liked Cyberpunk: Edgerunners 2. Perhaps understandably, a number of questions in the subsequent investors call put the focus on Grand Theft Auto 6 . While CD Projekt joint CEO Michał Nowakowski didn't go too deep on the topic, he did say that the upcoming Witcher 4 will be comparable to GTA 6 in at least one way. "Obviously, this is a call about us, not about Rockstar, but I do understand the connection here," Nowakowski said when asked if The Witcher 4 will represent a technological leap over its predecessor comparable to GTA 6. "Having said that, of course, I'm not going to make a deep dive and a full-blown review of GTA 5 versus GTA 6. But of course, we did look at the game. We did see the differences. "Do we believe there's going to be a comparable leap between Witcher 3 and Witcher 4? I think so, yes. I mean, it's been 11 years. We are working on The Witcher 4 to make it significantly better looking and improved in terms of pretty much every possible facet of the game. So yes, you should expect us to make a much bigger jump between Witcher 3 and Witcher 4." Well, sure. As Nowakowski said, The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt was released 11 years ago, and it'll be two more years before The Witcher 4 comes out—assuming it's not delayed, which would make it a rarity among CD Projekt games. It will also be the same number of years between Witcher 3 and 4 as spanned GTA 5 and 6. In the world of technology, 13 years is a long time. Hell, just the upgrade from the original Witcher 3 to the remastered version that dropped earlier this year is notable: At the same time, Nowakowski said that while the GTA 6 launch was tremendously successful, CD Projekt Red doesn't intend to merely mimic Rockstar's approach when The Witcher 4 is ready to go: "Our games are different and the require a certain different approach, and we just do certain things differently than they do." He also said that while the release of GTA 6 has had an impact on Witcher 3 and Cyberpunk 2077 sales on consoles, he doesn't expect it to have a "material impact" on the company's Q4 finances for one obvious reason. "You do have to remember that a lot of our players are also PC-based," Nowakowski said. "GTA has not launched on PC. We have not seen any impact whatsoever on the PC sales on engagement." And, he added, "on the PS5 and Xbox, it's not like our sales came to zero." Nowakowsi also said that GTA 6 hasn't changed CD Projekt's ambitions for The Witcher 4 and Cyberpunk 2: If anything, it's "an inspiration in many ways for our developers." And he's not concerned about its success pushing up development budgets, because CD Projekt's games "are not budget-driven developments." "I'm not saying that we don't care about the budgets. We do, and I'm pretty sure [Rockstar] did as well," Nowakowski said. "But you cannot make games like that having in mind, 'This is the fixed number of money I want to spend, and that's it. Otherwise, we're gone.' "They are ambition-driven developments and money is important. The budgets are not indefinite. That's not what we're saying. But the philosophy is kind of like I said. And honestly, that philosophy has not changed for us because of GTA 6's release. It has just always been like that." Nowakowski's positive take on GTA 6 isn't too far off that of Cyberpunk 2 creative director Igor Sarzynski, who said yesterday that he's suffering from " GTA 6-induced-open-world-game-dev-depression ," although he quickly clarified that CD Projekt is "doing something of our own, with a different unique flavor." (And that he wasn't being serious about cancelling Cyberpunk 2.) seriously though i think we're doing something of our own, with a different unique flavor. sources.text: GTA 6 é bom? Confira a review do aguardado Grand Theft Auto VI GTA 6 já está disponível e certamente deve servir de inspiração para diversos estúdios da indústria nos próximos anos. A CD Projekt RED, por exemplo, acredita que a evolução de The Witcher 3 para The Witcher 4 será comparável ao salto técnico e visual de GTA 5 e a sequência da Rockstar. A informação foi compartilhada durante uma reunião com investidores, na qual os executivos da desenvolvedora polonesa responderam a perguntas sobre o novo RPG e também comentaram o lançamento de GTA 6 — considerado o maior da história do entretenimento . Apesar de reconhecer que os dois projetos possuem propostas diferentes, a empresa acredita que o intervalo de 11 anos entre os jogos da franquia The Witcher permitirá uma evolução significativa. A promessa é de melhorias em praticamente todos os aspectos da experiência. Durante a reunião, um investidor questionou como The Witcher 4 se compara a GTA 6 , considerando o sucesso comercial e técnico do lançamento da Rockstar. O co-CEO da CD Projekt RED, Michal Nowakowski, ponderou que não seria adequado fazer uma comparação completa entre os dois projetos — mas reconheceu que a equipe acompanha os avanços da concorrência. “Antes de mais nada, esta ligação é sobre nós, não sobre a Rockstar, mas entendo a conexão”, afirmou o executivo. Ele também explicou que a desenvolvedora analisou as diferenças entre GTA 5 e GTA 6 para entender a dimensão da evolução apresentada pela sequência. Nowakowski acredita que uma transformação semelhante poderá ser observada entre The Witcher 3 e o próximo capítulo da franquia. Segundo ele, os 11 anos que separam os dois jogos representam uma grande janela de oportunidade para aprimorar consideravelmente os gráficos, a jogabilidade e outros elementos da experiência. “Acreditamos que haverá um salto comparável entre The Witcher 3 e The Witcher 4 . Já se passaram 11 anos. Estamos trabalhando em The Witcher 4 para torná-lo significativamente mais bonito e aprimorado em praticamente todos os aspectos do jogo”, declarou. O executivo completou: “Então, sim, vocês podem esperar um salto muito maior entre The Witcher 3 e The Witcher 4 ”. Durante a mesma reunião, os investidores também buscaram entender se o lançamento de GTA 6 poderia provocar mudanças no cronograma de desenvolvimento do próximo The Witcher — como ocorreu com outros estúdios alguns meses antes da estreia . A CD Projekt RED, porém, afirmou que não alterou seus planos por causa do jogo da Rockstar. A empresa também reiterou que The Witcher 4 continua previsto para 2028. Até o momento, não existe uma data específica de lançamento, mas a janela já havia sido mencionada anteriormente em atualizações sobre o desenvolvimento do RPG. Outro detalhe envolvendo o projeto é uma parceria de marketing com a Sony. O acordo indica que o PlayStation deverá ter participação importante na divulgação do jogo quando a campanha promocional começar, embora a empresa ainda não tenha apresentado detalhes sobre essa colaboração. Até agora, o público teve acesso apenas a cenas cinematográficas e a uma demonstração técnica que apresentou o jogo rodando no PlayStation 5 . O material mostrou recursos gráficos e desempenho do projeto no console, mas ainda não revelou uma demonstração completa da jogabilidade. A CD Projekt RED também já compartilhou alguns detalhes sobre o tamanho da equipe responsável pelo novo RPG. Em uma atualização publicada antes da Gamescom 2026, Michal Nowakowski confirmou que mais de 500 desenvolvedores estão trabalhando no projeto. “Nossa equipe aqui na sede da CD Projekt RED está trabalhando arduamente em uma saga totalmente nova, com Ciri no comando”, afirmou o executivo. A protagonista será o centro da próxima aventura, que dará início a uma nova fase da franquia. Na ocasião, Nowakowski também descreveu o jogo como o projeto mais ambicioso da história do estúdio. Segundo ele, The Witcher 4 terá um mundo aberto vasto, combates intensos e uma narrativa profunda, com lançamento previsto para 2028. E você, já está ansioso para The Witcher 4 ? sources.title: Lords of the Fallen 2 delayed to April 2027, release date coming next month
sources.text: The sequel was only announced last summer It's happening. We have some more movement on Lords of the Fallen 2 from CI Games. No, there still isn't a release date, but we know when we're getting one. The action RPG sequel is now due to arrive slightly later than previously announced, but still in the first half of 2027, and we'll be hearing more quite soon. Marek Tyminski, the CEO of CI Games, reveals the details himself. "Lords of the Fallen 2: April 2027," he writes on Twitter . "Exact date in December." What Tyminski's post doesn't specify this that this is actually another delay. The game was originally due in the back half of this year, before moving to the first quarter of 2027 . While it's slightly annoying to only get an announcement for the announcement, at least we know we don't have long to wait to find out when exactly Lords of the Fallen 2 is coming out. Knowing the release month is very helpful too. I could be wrong here, of course, but that seems to all but guarantee the game's presence at The Game Awards. Trailers and reveals are always a big part of the show, and I'm not sure where else we might see the follow-up otherwise, unless CI Games is planning some sort of livestream of its own we're not yet aware of. Regardless of the delay, this is all pretty quick turnaround for the release, since Lords of the Fallen 2 was only announced during the Opening Night Live of Gamescom 2025. Maybe I'm just jaded from increasingly elongated announcement schedules for blockbuster games, but getting the release window only a year and a half after the formal reveal is pretty tight by today's standards. I mean, we just waited years to find out what the full title of The Elder Scrolls 6 is. We'll see what CI Games has to offer come December, which, at time of writing, is just six days away. Maybe Mariah Carey will be involved in some way. I doubt it, but imagine. I bet she loves a bit of Lords of the Fallen, honestly. sources.text: Sony has confirmed the PlayStation Plus Monthly Games for December, which will be available to download from Tuesday, December 1 to Monday January 4. In a PlayStation Blog post , Sony said Tony Hawk’s Pro Skater 3+4, Dragon Ball Xenoverse 2, and Amnesia: The Bunker are December’s three titles. Will you be able to tear yourself away from GTA 6 to give either of these games a shot? Or perhaps you're after a palate cleanser after pumping 100 hours into Rockstar's epic? IGN's Tony Hawk’s Pro Skater 3 + 4 review returned an 8/10. We said: "Tony Hawk’s Pro Skater 3 + 4 proves yet again the series’ over-the-top skateboarding formula is totally timeless, even if some of the changes to THPS4 miss the mark and the soundtrack has been fumbled." Dragon Ball Xenoverse 2, meanwhile, got a 7.5 back in 2017 . "Dragon Ball Xenoverse 2 is an ambitious , if rough-edged experience, with deceptively deep RPG and brawling elements," we said at the time. And our Amnesia: The Bunker review returned an 8. We said: "Amnesia: The Bunker is a smaller, more self-contained episode in the groundbreaking horror franchise that shows Frictional still has some chilling new tricks up their sleeves." It’s worth noting that PlayStation Plus members have until Monday, November 30 to add the PlayStation Plus Monthly Games for November (Dead Island 2, Tomb Raider IV – VI Remastered, Monster Train 2) to their library. sources.title: The 25 Best PS5 Games in 2026
sources.text: What are the best games on PlayStation 5 ? Hard as it is to believe, the PS5 is — by Sony's own admission — already well past the halfway point of its life-cycle. (It's even time to start thinking about PS6 .) It's fair to say that PS5 hasn't been deluged with classics, and the rate of must-play new releases is slower than it has been on previous PlayStations. But it does now have the ultimate killer app: Grand Theft Auto 6 . That aside, the PS5's library has grown to the extent that there's a lot to sort through, and new and old PS5 owners will be wondering what to play. So here’s our living list of the best video games we’ve played on the platform — influenced by the personal tastes of the Polygon team — to be updated as more games come out. Our latest update to this list on Nov. 25 added Grand Theft Auto 6 . The Polygon staff plays a lot of video games, and everything in this list comes personally recommended by at least one of us. We determined what should be on our list of the best PlayStation 5 games by looking at the quality of each title, but also with an eye for breadth and variety — so you should find something on the list you’ll enjoy, no matter what genres of game you like, how much time you have, or what vibe you are after. A full six years into the PS5's life, here it is: the game that finally makes sense of this console generation, and makes it all worthwhile. GTA 6 is the best-reviewed game of all time, and you don't have to spend long with it to understand why. It's a deeply engrossing world of astonishing detail, reactivity, and scope, rendered in all the seedy, dayglo glamor that can be mustered by the most expensive video game production of all time. It's a familiarly scattershot satire of modern life in America. But — and it's a huge but — it's also a game of real sensitivity and heart. The central couple of Jason and Lucia are straight-up adorable and Rockstar shows, for the first time in the series' history, a moving willingness to see the best in people. Well... some people. —OW Read Giovanni Colantonio's full review of Grand Theft Auto 6 . If you're craving a return to the days of Wipeout, when a PlayStation racing game was as likely to involve antigravity sci-fi craft rocketing around at hundreds of miles per hour as realistic cars, then Galactic Racer is the game for you. It also happens to be one of the most innovative racing games in a long time, a much-needed shake-up for a stale genre. It introduces a roguelite structure and build-crafting into both single-player and even multiplayer modes, while keeping it all totally coherent with a very Star Wars fantasy of racing dangerous, rickety hot rods. As a treat, there's a healthy dose of Burnout in there, too. —Oli Welsh Read Oli Welsh's full review of Star Wars: Galactic Racer . Here's another classic PlayStation flavor resurrected in an unexpectedly glorious way. As the latest in Bandai Namco's long-running dogfighting air combat series, Ace Combat 8 sounds like a niche known quantity. Try it, however, and you'll be pleasantly surprised again and again: by the sophistication of the controls, the variety of the level design, the meaty length of the campaign, the amazing fidelity of the visuals, and the depth and seriousness of its operatic wartime storyline. —OW Read Giovanni Colantonio 's full review of Ace Combat 8: Wings of Theve . The PS5 generation has been a bit short on really great tactics games, but that's all changed with this superb squad strategy game from Bit Reactor, set during Star Wars' Clone Wars era. Many on the team worked on Firaxis' XCOM reboot games, and you can sure tell — this is fine-honed game design full of precision, personality, puzzle-like ingenuity, and just the right amount of unpredictability. Zero Company also makes brilliant use of its setting, compellingly painting a grunt's-eye-view of the collapse of the Republic, and assembling a squad of characters you'll really care about. Especially when you lose them forever in the default permadeath setting. —OW Read Elijah Gonzalez's full review of Star Wars Zero Company . It's been a long time since there was an official James Bond game, and a much longer time — almost 30 years, in fact — since there was a really great one. 007 First Light might not attain the legendary status of GoldenEye 007 , but it's a very slick and entertaining blockbuster action game that's a lot smarter than it needed to be. The key is an inspired choice of developer in IO Interactive, of Hitman fame. IO's love of open-ended "social stealth" gameplay sneaks its way in between the set-pieces and rounds out a thoroughly satisfying adventure with a unique perspective on a young Bond. — OW Read Ford James' full review of 007 First Light . It's defiantly not for everyone, but when the planets align, Bungie's take on the extraction shooter genre can be a totally electrifying multiplayer experience. Its asymmetric PvPvE gameplay can be hard to get your head around, never mind brutally unforgiving, but for intensity and drama it can hardly be matched, and Bungie is to be commended for including interesting solo as well as group roles. On top of this, you have intriguingly deep sci-fi world-building, Bungie's world-class gamefeel — 25 years on from Halo , there are still no more satisfying guns to shoot in gaming — and absolutely stunning art direction, realising one a compellingly chilling future. — OW Read Corey Plante's impressions of Marathon . You can accuse this sequel to Supergiant Games' smash hit roguelike action game of overcomplicating the pure brilliance of the first Hades , and we did. But really this is quibbling with something that's very close to perfection. The combat is still crisp and thrilling, the randomized boons are still exquisitely balanced, the see-saw between progression and setback on each run is still perfectly judged, and the languid, sexy bickering of Supergiant's take on the pantheon of Greek mythology is still gloriously characterful

The game uses XBOX Series S graphics settings when cloud-streamed with XBOX Cloud Gaming. Here's how to save on what's arguably the biggest game of all time. Despite Black Friday still being a week away, the store has slashed £16.14 off the standard Xbox version of Grand Theft Auto VI, bringing its usual £69.99 price down to £53.85 at ShopTo . That's 23% off for a direct digital code, with instant delivery, and no additional vouchers or memberships needed. Better still, there are a few other ways to save on Rockstar's latest blockbuster, depending on whether you're playing on Xbox or PS5, or fancy getting some bonus content with your purchase via the Ultimate Edition As for PS5 players, ShopTo's cheapest route is a little different, since getting digital game keys for PlayStation games outside of boxed codes and PlayStation itself is a lot trickier compared to Xbox titles. Instead of receiving GTA 6 itself, ShopTo can sell you a £70 PlayStation Store gift card for only £60.85 , which you can then redeem on your UK PSN account to buy the £69.99 Standard Edition — effectively earning you £9.15 in savings. On the other hand, for anyone who wants the closest thing to a physical version of GTA 6, both consoles have a £61.85 boxed option with an added A3 double-sided poster ; that also makes ShopTo the cheapest UK retailer to buy the boxed version of Grand Theft Auto VI from right now. Remember, though, these aren't actual disc versions of GTA 6; you'll find a download code inside the packaging instead. Also, for Xbox fans who were considering buying the Grand Theft Auto 6’s Ultimate Edition anyway, ShopTo also has said Ultimate Edition on Xbox for only £67.85 — an incredibly impressive £22.14 price drop and the lowest price we’ve seen for it yet. With the Ultimate Edition, compared to the Standard Edition of GTA VI, you’ll get extra vehicles, weapons, outfits, customisation features, and exclusive locations throughout Leonida. To get that aforementioned Ultimate Edition on PS5, however, you can also grab the £100 PlayStation Store Gift Card for only £85.85 to redeem the complete version of GTA 6 for £89.99. Sure, you’ll only save £41.14 instead of buying the game through the PS Store directly, but you’ll have an extra £10 credit to spend on other games and DLC on top. Otherwise, if you’re unsure about getting the Ultimate Edition on PlayStation 5 right away, you can always buy the £20 Ultimate Edition Upgrade directly from the PlayStation Store . The same goes for the bonus Grand Theft Auto VI Vintage Vice City Pack for £4.49 — featuring the stunning ’55 Vapid Stanier sedan and garage alongside Ocean Beach, alternative outfits and hairstyles for both Jason and Lucia, and an exclusive Tropical Weapon Pattern inspired by Tommy Vercetti's iconic palm-tree shirt. At the time of writing, there is no physical disc version of GTA 6, along with there being no indication by Rockstar Games as to whether it will be putting out a disc'd edition of the game; with that, these deals are some of the best value you can get on the Grand Theft Auto sequel in the meantime. sources.text: Grand Theft Auto 6 is everywhere you look. Every news channel is talking about it. Celebrities and musicians are playing GTA 6 or posting about its release. It’s apparently the biggest game ever and has sold nearly 40 million copies already . But if you aren’t a big gamer or not a video game fan at all, you might have questions. I have answers. Perhaps someone sent you this link because you kept asking them GTA 6 questions. Maybe you did a Google search, made it past the AI results and found this blog explaining what GTA 6 is to people who don’t buy or play games. Whatever the case, welcome. I’m going to walk you through what is almost certainly the biggest video game launch of the decade , why people are going so wild, and what the game actually is and isn’t. It is an open-world game that mixes together a lot of video game genres, like driving, shooting, and exploration. As with most open-world games, you can run around freely or do story missions. It’s up to the player. You control two characters, Jason and Lucia, who are criminals on the run in fictional versions of Florida and Miami named Leonida and Vice City, respectively. More or less, yeah. The developer, Rockstar Games, has been working on this game since at least 2015 or so. Turns out creating a photorealistic recreation of a chunk of Florida that players can explore and do whatever they want in takes time! No. You can buy it on either PS5 or Xbox for $80. The $100 version comes with a bunch of extra outfits , hairstyles, and other items players can wear or buy in-game using cash they collect from crimes, but it’s definitely not required. It took me about 90 hours to reach the end of the main story. I’ve since played over 150 hours, and I’m still finding new stuff, hearing new songs, and seeing new random events. Yeah, it’s big. Well, a lot of people have been waiting for 13 years to play GTA 6 . The last new GTA game, GTA V , was released back in 2013. So anticipation for this game has been building for a long time. And, surprisingly, GTA 6 lived up to the hype. There are a few reasons for the glowing critical reception. The game’s narrative is really good, featuring two extremely well-written characters that develop a meaningful relationship over the course of its five chapters. Another big reason for the high review scores is just how expansive and reactive the world is. Characters in the game will comment on your clothes, respond to your actions, and remember things you did hours and hours ago. It’s also a lot of fun to play, with challenging but rewarding driving, combat, and police encounters. And it looks incredible, with some of the best graphics ever seen in a console game. Some critics are calling it the best game of the year. And many players are calling it one of the best games ever. GTA: Vice City on the PS2 was much, much smaller and less advanced (though in some ways it was pretty advanced for the time) and was set in the 1980s. While Vice City is a major location in GTA 6 , this is an unconnected and different version of the city from that seen in the original 2002 PS2 game. So many things! Players can steal cars, drive boats, get into fist fights, shoot at the cops, go fishing, play mini-golf, hit the gun range, pet dogs, scuba dive, fly planes, explore the swamps, hunt deer, join in street races, visit the beach, get drunk, buy clothes, play fake video games inside the game, take a shower, eat food, work out, blow up cars, or just chill in a bar. You can also just play through the game’s main story, which is all about Jason and Lucia trying to make some money as criminals to build a life for themselves and their son. Yes, Jason and Lucia have a child, a fact which was omitted from any pre-release marketing but is revealed in the first 20 minutes of the game. During the events of the game, he is living with his aunt while Lucia and Jason do whatever they can to make a good life for him and get him back. She is an attractive but disturbing character players meet very early in the game who may or may not be a serial killer or creepy stalker. Despite this, many people online still want to have sex with her. Some players also think Jason should hook up with Mandy and ditch Lucia. These people are wrong. No. While you can do that stuff, GTA 6 doesn’t force you to be a good boyfriend. You can be a real jerk to Lucia, and she can be a real asshole to Jason. Also, the chores players are talking about only make up a few minutes of the opening hours of GTA 6. The rest of the game has none of that stuff in it. Like the chores mentioned already, these elements are optional. If you constantly skip working out, your characters will eventually become less ripped and might even develop small bellies and thicker thighs. But you can still play all the missions and shoot cops. What? You can totally shoot random people, cops, and more. That’s not accurate. You can shoot, punch, tackle, burn, run over, drown, choke, and slap women. Uhh, you can steal cars. Some cars, like very fancy cars, have special security measures, so you can’t steal them as easily, but you can walk up to any person driving a car at a stoplight, rip them out and take their ride. Okay, so, something you need to understand about GTA 6 is that it is at the center of a massive online culture war. Conservative players, grifters, chuds, and other weirdos are currently spreading false information about this game online. There are also plenty of people online posting inflammatory nonsense to get clicks and engagement on sites like Twitter that reward that shit. So if you read something kind of wild about this game, just know it might be false. Check places like Kotaku or other major gaming sites to verify. sources.text: A CD Projekt Red anunciou uma nova parceria comercial com a Sony Interactive Entertainment que envolve a campanha de marketing de The Witcher 4 e a distribuição de jogos do estúdio no ecossistema PlayStation . O anúncio foi realizado nesta terça-feira (24), durante a apresentação dos resultados financeiros do terceiro trimestre de 2026 da desenvolvedora polonesa. Segundo Piotr Nielubowicz, diretor financeiro da CD Projekt Red, os acordos foram assinados no mesmo dia e devem contribuir para os resultados comerciais e financeiros da companhia nos próximos anos. Apesar da parceria, o acordo não estabelece exclusividade para The Witcher 4. O RPG continua em desenvolvimento para PlayStation 5 , Xbox Series X|S e PC. A colaboração envolve principalmente a futura campanha publicitária do título, seguindo um modelo semelhante ao adotado pela Sony em sua parceria de marketing com a Rockstar Games para o lançamento de GTA 6. O contrato também contempla a presença de jogos da CD Projekt Red no catálogo do PlayStation Plus . Entretanto, as empresas não divulgaram quais títulos serão disponibilizados no serviço de assinatura. Os valores financeiros e demais condições comerciais do acordo também não foram revelados. De acordo com informações do Video Games Chronicle (VGC), The Witcher 4 segue com previsão de lançamento para 2028. Atualmente, quase metade da equipe de desenvolvimento da CD Projekt Red está dedicada ao projeto. O RPG marcará o início de uma nova trilogia da franquia. Segundo os planos apresentados anteriormente pelo estúdio, a intenção é lançar os três jogos dentro de um intervalo de seis anos. A estratégia representa uma aposta da desenvolvedora na continuidade da franquia e na redução do intervalo entre seus grandes lançamentos. sources.title: How to get abducted and find aliens in GTA 6
sources.text: To find aliens in GTA 6 you need to be abducted, then wait for dream to tell you what to do next The GTA 6 alien mission starts with an abduction that leads to some weird dreams, and eventually sends you off to literally find what's out there. Spoilers obviously abound for everything I'm about to tell you below, but if you want to see what the latest instalment of Grand Theft Auto's alien stuff is, read on. To start everything off you first need to be abducted. There's an element of luck here but what you're looking is to see a car by the side of the road with all its doors open and lights going crazy . It seems like there might be a few locations it can happen, and it can only happen at night, but for me it was here in Port Gellhorn: Follow the cars headlights and you should see some clothes scattered around. Using your flashlight and Focus you'll see more clothes making a trail you can follow. Eventually you'll see a light, and pick up something... else with your Focus. I won't spoil it too much: Once this sequence plays out you'll get the objective to go back to the woman's car. This is what triggers your own abduction experience. Once that's done you'll wake up by the side of the road apparently unharmed. To continue the GTA 6 alien quest you'll need to go to sleep to trigger some dreams. It might take a day or two but keep sleeping and you should eventually have some strange dreams. It needs to be the same character that was abducted, obviously, in case you're not seeing anything happen. This dream is actually an explainer on how to rescue an alien, although there's a tricky puzzle to get past first. Leaving the room you woke up in will take you to a large dark room full of eggs with a bright light at the center. The eggs will explode if you get too close, and once a few have popped you'll be grabbed by a tentacle. This will restart the dream with the option to 'give up', but don't. If you're having trouble all you need to do is sneak past slowly. If you crouch and keep your speed as low as possible you shouldn't pop any eggs, no matter how angry they look. Weekly digests, tales from the communities you love, and more You'll need to find a path through the eggs as it's a bit of a maze, but as long you move low and slow you should be able to reach the light in the middle easily, which will end this sequence. Once past the alien eggs you'll reach a room with a model solar system in it. The Earth is actually a picture of a location, so examine that and move on. Next you'll see a keypad with a series of lines over it. These lines denote the alien key pad code and are randomised. For me it was 3214 but you might have something different. Don't worry about memorising it, as it will be noted like the GTA 6 safe codes you can find elsewhere. Once you're through you'll find a control panel to use. Switch it on and you'll see four buttons you'll need to turn green: Pushing any button will cycle the light either side of it through off, orange and then green. Using that info you'll need to make all the lights green and then press another button to reveal three doors ahead of you. Through to door on the left you'l find some milk to fetch, and through the door on the right you'll find a machine you can put the milk in. The door in the middle has a burning sun inside that will kill you. We don't open the middle door. Get the milk and take it to the machine. Placing it in the slot will then end this whole sequence and you'll wake up. The radio tower you saw in your dream is at the location shown on the map above - just above Shoeless Keys. Drive there and use your car to encourage the gates to open, as there's barbed wire everywhere. Go around the building to this door and head inside: Immediately inside you'll see some stairs down to a door locked with a keypad. Use the code you got in your dream to open it. This will then take you down via lift to a control room where you'll find a tape you can play on a table, and then repeat what you learned in the dream: Putting the milk in the machine will open the door and reveal the alien. However, make sure you have full health before you pick it up. The second you grab the ET poison gas will start flooding the place, and you'll need to get to the lift as fast as possible while your health drains. Head outside and let the events play out. When it's all over you'll have your health, stamina and focus all permanently increased. For reasons your car will probably be impounded and end up at the police station nearest your current home. If you are miles from home at this point, simply switch to the other character and then call up and arrange to meet. This will teleport whoever was stranded immediately back to you. © GamesRadar+. sources.title: Wait, What? GTA 6 Runs Better On Xbox Series X Than PS5
sources.text: Digital Foundry Grand Theft Auto VI GTA 6 Rockstar When it comes toÂ GTA 6 , PlayStation has very much been the teacher’s pet. Microsoft was operating under a weird-ass ban that prevented it from marketing the fact that the game was coming out on its console, while the PS5 has been broadly promoted as the natural home for Rockstar’s record-breaking release. And yet, Digital Foundry ‘s latest analysis ofÂ GTA 6 ‘s performance across all four of Microsoft and Sony’s current-gen systems shows the Series X outdoing the PS5. “Ultimately,” the site’s boffins report, “Series X is meaningfully better off.” It’s important to mention right away that the PS5 Pro still wipes the floor with the Series X, and is without doubt the best way to play Grand Theft Auto VI until the official PC version is released. But when you measure the two base machines between the rival console makers,Â DF says there’s no doubt that it’s the Series X that edges ahead of the PS5. Both consoles offer “a virtually identical visual presentation,” say the tech experts, with nothing to divide them in all the important areas. But when it comes to performance, this is where Xbox takes the lead. Both machines struggle during “heavy vehicle traversal” and “intense airport crowd sequences,” but the PS5 “suffers substantially more frequent frame-rate drops” than the Series X, “which is compounded by the fact that the Xbox machine also benefits from 120Hz VRR support to smooth out minor dips.” Unsurprisingly, the Series S performs the poorest out of all four, but actually offers better results than anyone was expecting. While its framerate drops are horrible, frequently dipping into the teens, the use of PSR 4.1 upscaling and a reduction in the most intensive details still has it looking pretty lovely. It’s definitely not a great way to play the game, but it’s less terrible than you’d think. So there you go, Xbox owners: you’re not the ugly stepsister you might have been made to feel like. Obviously the differences remain slight, and with both consoles (and even the PS5 Pro) capped to 30 FPS there are compromises to be made by all, so whether you’re playing on PlayStation or Xbox Series X, you’re mostly having the same experience. sources.title: Remedy CEO praises Rockstar's support for the Max Payne 1 & 2 remake and respecting Remedy's creative vision
sources.text: "I'll say it out loud: They've honestly been an awesome partner." Alan Wake and Control studio Remedy Entertainment is currently developing a highly-anticipated Max Payne 1 & 2 remake. The Finnish studio is doing so in partnership with Grand Theft Auto 6 studio Rockstar, which owns the IP and is funding the remake's development. So how has that relationship been? According to Remedy CEO Jean-Charles Gaudechon, working with Rockstar has been "amazing". "Honestly, it's been great," Gaudechon told Game File . "You know why? Because I think they're super respectful of Remedy." Gaudechon is so positive on Remedy's working relationship with Rockstar that he emphasised his praise for Rockstar further. "I'll say it out loud: They've honestly been an awesome partner. And it's no bullshit," he added. The original Max Payne was released in 2001, and its sequel in 2003 - both developed by Remedy. Rockstar published the second game and worked on the original's console ports. Rockstar developed a third entry in the series, Max Payne 3 , which Rockstar co-founder Dan Houser recently called something of a failure . "Some people liked it; lots didn't. So we got it wrong, or I got it wrong. I failed. My bit was not a success," said Houser. The Max Payne 1 & 2 remake has been in the works since 2022 , but only entered full production in 2024 . The game is understood to be Remedy's current project, though the studio also has another unannounced project in the works. In other Remedy news, the studio recently posted one of its best financial quarters , off the back of the release of Control Resonant, the studio's fastest-selling game ever .

sources.title: GTA 6 Cooties Mission Walkthrough
sources.text: Wondering how to complete Cooties in GTA 6? The Cooties mission in GTA 6 sees Lucia join Dre’Quan Priest and the Real Dimez to film a music video for their latest track. However, the shoot takes an unexpected turn when DWNPLY and his crew arrive looking for revenge. If you’re struggling to complete the mission, here’s how to shoot the music video, escape DWNPLY’s crew and unlock the Bae-Luxe’s Bat reward. Guides: If you're playing Grand Theft Auto 6, make sure to checkÂ out ourÂ complete walkthrough hub , featuringÂ beginner tips , navigation experience explained , GTA 6 cheats , and more. To unlock Cooties, you’ll first need to complete the Ride or Die mission in Chapter 3. After a couple of in-game days, Jason’s friend Dre’Quan will contact you about filming a music video for the Real Dimez song, Cooties. To start the mission, head to the mission marker in Crosstown. For the first part of the mission you’ll play as Lucia during the music video shoot, which features DWNPLY’s stolen car from the Ride or Die mission. The first mission objective is to help the Real Dimez film their music video. Most of this section is scripted, but you’ll need to complete a few actions. You’ll need to drive the car on a predetermined route so that it can be filmed for the video. After driving through the city, you’ll eventually stop, at which point some guys will start harassing Lucia and the Dimez. Get out the car as Lucia and knock the guy out. You won’t be able to pull weapons here, but you won’t need to, he’ll go down in one punch. Once the confrontation is over, the girls will begin smashing up the car for the cameras. Lucia is handed a baseball bat, allowing you to join in. Finally, you’ll need to spray-paint the vehicle. Shake the spray can using X on PlayStation or A on Xbox , then hold R2/RT to paint the side of the car. With the music video finished, DWNPLY and his crew arrive looking for their car. Jump behind the wheel and make your escape. You’ll need to lose the pursuing vehicles and drive outside the red danger area displayed on your map. If you destroy the car, the mission will fail, or if either of the Dimez are thrown out of the car due to a big crash, the mission will also fail. Keep moving and if any of the DWNPLY cars get too close, shoot their wheels in Focus Mode to take them out quickly. Once all the pursuing cars have disappeared and you’ve escaped the marked area, the objective will update. With DWNPLY’s crew gone,Â follow the objective marker towards the recording studio. Drive the damaged vehicle towards the destination to trigger the final sequence and complete the mission.

sources.title: All GTA 6 Kitty Litter lab locations
sources.text: Take Out Kitty Litter for Tyrone across the Vice City. Taking Out Kitty Litter's lab locations in GTA 6 is a mission in Tyrone's questline, and sees you searching the city for 18 secret labs (after the first one he directs you to). Every lab has a red smoking chimney and a blue and white Spin On This laundry van parked outside. It'll take a little while, but it's well worth it to get the unique gold SMG at the end. Plus, Tyrone will start buying narcotics from you for the highest price possible. To destroy each lab, simply shoot a smoking pink flask and then run away. I've also laid these out in the most optimal order , separated into regions, so you're not driving back and forth across Vice City. Last note: if you want to unlock map markers for the labs yourself versus relying on these videos, you can threaten cooks in certain labs to potentially reveal them, or talk to Tyrone when you're fencing goods. After you complete some missions for Tyrone (when you meet him with Dre'Quan during Dealer's Choice ) he'll direct you to this trailer park in La Perle where you destroy the first Kitty Litter lab and start the hunt for the others. You can see the route to the lab in the video above. You can find this one in the trailer park opposite Zenon's Pawn Shop Ammu-Nation in La Perle. As soon as you go through the main gate, you can see the trailer with the funnel chimney where they're cooking straight ahead. Sneak around the back and break inside to find the lab. Or take out the three guys in front and go in that way. Just across the road from the Mezzasega Espresso and Slinger in the Decor District. Pull off to the right of the road into the Williams + Whitaker Homeware and Decor car park. You'll see a garage with a shutter at the far end with a smoking chimney and the laundry van parked. Open the shutter to find a lone guy in the lab. This one is behind Peterson's Autoshop in Rockridge, directly south across the road from the Blessed Food Market, under the overpass, on the border between Rockridge and La Perle. Head through the main yard and turn left to spot the laundry van. Break into it, move it forward, and open the shutter behind to find the lab. Just east of Fleeca Field stadium, next door to Xero Gas - Rockridge. You'll spot the blue and white laundry van parked off to the side of the road behind a wall. Head down that alley and turn right to find a garage door you can open with the lab inside. On the east side of the condominium building directly south of the Vice City Hospital, by Emilio's Auto Center Gas. Look for the closed road with the laundry van parked at the southern end and some staircases and flats off to the side with the chimney spewing smoke. The lab is through the white door on the bottom floor. Just down the road to the west of Bump and Grind coffee and Salon Belle, in a block of flats southeast of Fleeca Fields stadium. You can see the laundry van parked outside. The lab is on the upper floor on the left side in apartment 5, where you can see the smoking chimney. Break in via the front door to find the lab. This lab is an easy one to find, around the back of Cross My Heart Tattoos. Head around the right side, turn left, and look to your left for the garage door with the guy sitting down guarding it, with the lab inside. This lab is in the block of flats to the southeast of the Jack of Hearts and Urban Legendz, with the laundry van parked out front. Look inside apartment 103 on the first floor on the left side. It's quite hard to get away from this lab blowing up, so shoot it from outside and run away. Also this will likely cause a big shootout in the block, so book it. This lab is to the southwest of your apartment in Chapter 3 and to the east of the Crosstown Mule - City Line marker. Look for an overgrown lot with the laundry van parked in it. The garage with the lab is just behind that. This lab is directly west of Down Town Pawn, just between Rideout Customs and the Vargo's Gas station. Just past the gas station, look to the left where its fuel sign is to spot a laundry van, and further down the track, the garage with the lab and smoking chimney above it. This lab is close to Xero Gas - Tequesta and west of Vice Seven Condominiums gym. When driving east to west past the station, turn right and keep an eye on your right towards the two floored condominiums for the laundry van parked outside. You want the set of staircases to the right of the van. Take the right side one up to the first floor to find the lab door directly ahead. This lab is in a trailer park directly east down the road from Arrow Gas - VCIA, also west under the bridge from Pawn City and Vice City Firearms. Turn into the trailer park, take the first right and drive a little way around the corner to spot the trailer with the smoking chimney on the left. You can enter via a window around the other side to find the lab. This lab is located in the far south of Salton, north of the Pay 'N' Spray - Salton, next door to the Slator Towing Inc robbery. Go around the south side of the derelict block of flats and climb the dumpster to jump up through the open window to find the lab. This lab is west down the road from Xero Gas - Salton. Cross the train tracks, then keep an eye on your right for a carpark with a blue and white laundry van, then turn right into it to spot the building with the smoking chimney on the right. Hop the fence straight ahead and turn right to find one guy guarding the garage with the lab. This lab is easy to find, directly south of Salon Perez and Safia Restaurant in Little Cuba. Look for some bungalows on the left with the laundry van parked outside. It's in the building with the chimney to the left of the one the van is parked in front of. The lab is the second door along. This lab is north up the road from the Pay 'N' Spray - Balsero. Turn left down the alley with the laundry van parked to find a guy guarding the gate, a couple of guys inside, and the lab in an open garage further back

sources.title: All Peewees Billboard locations in GTA 6
sources.text: How to claim the Peewees Billboard grand prize How to claim the Peewees Billboard grand prize Peewees Billboards are one of the many scannable WAiNK collectibles in Grand Theft Auto 6 , but they're also part of the Mr. Enigma X Peewees scavenger hunt. Mr. Enigma, a play on Dr. Pepper, and the Peewees, a play on Popeyes, have teamed up to create a challenge where you must find four Peewees billboards, and you'll earn a valuable reward. All the info you're given is that there is a billboard in the following areas: Vice-Dale, Mariana County, Lummox County, and Leonard County. As these areas are fairly large, it can take a long time to find them. To save you some time, we've listed where you can find every Peewees Billboard in GTA 6 below. To start the Mr. Enigma X Peewees scavenger hunt, look out for a Peewees post on Snapmatic, or you can look for one of the four Peewees billboards. After you start, you'll get a text from Chicken Challenge, telling you that you've entered the scavenger hunt. They'll also send you a clue that points you toward another billboard when you start the challenge and every time you find one. There are four Peewees Billboards in GTA 6 , with one in Vice-Dale, Mariana County, Lummox County, and Leonard County. To mark them off the list, head to their location and scan them using WAiNK (hold Up on your D-pad). Below, we explain where you can find each billboard in detail. The Vice-Dale Peewees Billboard is on the west side of Balsero , which is the northwest corner of Vice-Dale County . The billboard itself is between Route US-10 and US-35 , which is just northwest of Randy's shop . The Mariana County Peewees Billboard is technically in Big Pine in Grassrivers , but it's very close to the border between Grassrivers and North Mariana County . Along the border, you'll find three dome-shaped buildings and Route US-82 . Head northeast of the dome-shaped buildings , and look in the median strip to find this Peewee Billboard. The Lummox County Peewees Billboard is located on the border between South West Lummox County and Mount Kalaga National Park . The billboard is just west of Route US-628 . Head north from the junction that connects US-628 to SR-73 , and you'll find the billboard on your left. The Leonard County Peewees Billboard is located in the northwest corner of Waning Sands . The billboard is just next to SR-27 , which is between Lake Leonida and Mount Hailes Club . Look northeast of Lake Leonida, and you'll find the golf course. Follow along the road until you find the Peewees Billboard. After you find every Peewees Billboard, you'll receive a text from Chicken Challenge, telling you that you won... almost! You just need to solve one more puzzle, but they don't tell you what the puzzle is. If you take a look back at the clues that Chicken Challenge has been sending you, you'll notice that a couple of letters in each photo are covered by the Peewees logo. The following letters are blocked off: V - L - I - L - L - E - B - E. Now, it looks like a bunch of gibberish, but if you scramble the letters, you'll get Belville , which is the southern region of Leonard County . It just so happens that there's a Peewees in Belville. To claim your grand prize, you need to head to the Peewees in Belville, which is just east of the hospital. Alternatively, you can open your map, scroll down to the "Fast Food" section of the "Food & Drink" tab, and select the Peewees in Belville to speed up the process. Head inside and speak with the manager to claim your reward, which is a Peewees hat, a Peewees shirt, and free Peewees food! If you're just getting started in GTA 6 , we have plenty of guides to help you live the high life in Leonida. Check out our GTA 6 beginner guide to get a grasp of the basics and our tips for what to do first , recommendations for the best ways to make money fast , and an explainer for how to keep stolen weapons and cars to make the most of your free time. Our selection of GTA 6 guides includes help for things like how to steal the Phoenix in "Unwanted Attention" and whether you should defuse Mandy , too. There's a set of explainers for GTA 6 's more open-ended side activities, like how to rob the Exotic Animal Front and where to find tree effigies for the Skunk Ape mission , and we've got all the GTA 6 cheat codes . You'll have to put in some effort before you can use those, though.
